observations: A heavy-duty automatic transmission with a large cylindrical housing.
The unit is mounted on a metal frame with a single wheel.
The exterior surface shows significant dirt, grime, and some rust.
A label on the side of the transmission reads 'A8L' and 'A2F'.
The transmission is shown in a disassembled state with the input shaft and output shaft visible.
The interior of the transmission is not shown in any of the photos.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The transmission may be a used part or a rebuilt unit rather than a genuine Audi part.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's identification plate on the side of the transmission.
risks.if_unproven: as a used or rebuilt unit

risks.risk: Internal mechanical damage such as seized gears or a faulty synchronizer.
risks.proof: A video showing the transmission being shifted through all gears and the fluid being checked.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged internal components like the input shaft or output shaft.
risks.proof: A photo of the internal gears and shafts.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate on the side of the transmission.
Video of the transmission being shifted through all gears.
Photo of the internal gears and shafts.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
